judge_notes: Hard call: both reviews raise capacitive/Coulomb coupling between the two AB loops as a source of the f11 mixing frequency; counted as coulomb-dominated-interferometer (Coulomb charging setting the oscillation pattern), though the library entry is phrased for bulk-edge charging. Protocol-parameter-sensitivity counted for the asymptotic-fit window and dropped low-T points; B's domain coexistence near 9.5 T counted as percolation, its excitation-current/electron-temperature point as heating, and its device/cooldown count as fine-tuning-and-selection.
